headline: As of 2026-11-04: 69,458,264 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 69,458,264 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (9,305,860), Florida (8,329,722), Texas (8,174,590).
